note: Identity record for every artifact in this repository that mirrors a Drive object. OP-PROT-019 section 2: 'The digest establishes identity, not truth or authorization.' None of these copies is byte-identical to its source object. They are READING COPIES. Reviewing one of these files is not reviewing the object the registers name.
discovered: 2026-09-18, by the nonauthor technical review of RV-OPS-R17 recorded at reviews/records/REV-OPS-R17-001.json, finding 1. The review was of this repository's own migration and it found a real defect in it.
